rationale: The expression is internally coherent and the diagnosis (average score can be carried by one good year) is sensible, but swapping MA for TS_MIN on the already-tested "Balanced Research Funding Match" reuses the same floor operator applied in at least four prior archive entries, making this an incremental variant rather than a substantively different mechanism.

This is a pure operator swap (nested MIN → rank product) on the archived "Cash-Deficient Leveraged Goodwill," and its two-way ancestor "Leveraged Goodwill Fragility" already used exactly this rank-product form, so it tests no new economic content.

Dropping dp from the archived "Intangible Renewal Free Cash" leaves a numerator dominated by oancf, so after the TS_MIN floor the signal collapses toward TS_MIN(oancf/at,3) — essentially cash-based operating profitability, already embedded in several archive entries — and the SUB(at,at) zero kludge signals expression-language strain rather than a new mechanism.

The organic-versus-acquired intangible composition ratio is a genuinely new and economically motivated construct, though it is bolted onto an already-strong standalone leg (R&D-Adjusted Cash Margin Floor) via a MIN-of-ranks form that has repeatedly diluted rather than improved evidence in this archive, and the many gdwl=0 firms will pile up at the ratio's ceiling.

The sign logic is internally consistent (high score = R&D cut plus deteriorating cash profitability → negative returns) and the R&D-retrenchment × cash-decline interaction is not in the archive, but the second leg alone is close to the known change-in-profitability effect, and the stated motivation references a prior R&D-cut result that does not appear in the archive.

This is a bare lookback-window tweak (TS_SUM(xrd,5) → TS_SUM(xrd,3)) on the archive's best-performing signal, which is a hyperparameter sensitivity check rather than a new hypothesis, and the coverage rationale is weak since the R&D-history requirement is what binds regardless of horizon.
